statBlock.name: Aartuk Elder
statBlock.description: A bark-covered warrior spreads five suction-tipped branches around its stalk head. Aartuks roam Wildspace in war bands after beholders destroyed their old homeworld.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The aartuk can cross difficult climbing surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Branch or Radiant Pellet for each.
Branch. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Radiant Pellet. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (4d4) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell below without components. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 12).
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Detect Magic, Sending.
sections.Bonus actions: Tongue (Recharge 6). Choose one Large or smaller creature the aartuk can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is grappled by the tongue (escape DC 14) and pulled up to 25 ft. toward the aartuk. The tongue can hold only one creature.

statBlock.name: Aartuk Starhorror
statBlock.description: A star-shaped plant with a stalk head creeps along the ceilings of captured spelljammers. A starhorror can rally a shaken war band or revive a fallen ally.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The aartuk can cross difficult climbing surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Branch or Radiant Pellet for each.
Branch. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Radiant Pellet. Ranged spell attack, +2 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (3d4) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell below without components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
1/day each. Revivify, Speak with Plants.
sections.Bonus actions:
Rally the Troops (1/day). The starhorror magically ends the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and any creatures it chooses that it can see within 30 ft.
Tongue (Recharge 6). Choose one Medium or smaller creature the aartuk can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is grappled by the tongue (escape DC 11) and pulled up to 25 ft. toward the aartuk. The tongue can hold only one creature.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 9. The official errata renamed the Aartuk Priest and updated its skill and spell list.

statBlock.name: Aartuk Weedling
statBlock.description: These war-band fighters cling to walls and ceilings on suction cups. A weedling shoots a sticky tongue to pull prey within reach of its branches.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The aartuk can cross difficult climbing surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Branch or Radiant Pellet for each.
Branch. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Radiant Pellet. Ranged spell attack, +3 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (3d4 + 1) radiant damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Tongue (Recharge 6). Choose one Medium or smaller creature the aartuk can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is grappled by the tongue (escape DC 12) and pulled up to 25 ft. toward the aartuk. The tongue can hold only one creature.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 9. The official errata renamed the Aartuk Warrior.

statBlock.name: Adult Lunar Dragon
statBlock.description: This moon dragon tunnels through rock and hoards trophies taken from trespassing crews. When it phases, half its body looks like a dark silhouette.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (2/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.
Tunneler. The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel 15 ft. in diameter.
Unusual Nature. The dragon needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and its speed becomes 0 through the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and its speed stays the same.
sections.Bonus actions: Phase (3/day). The dragon turns partly incorporeal while it maintains Concentration as if on a spell. It gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for the duration. This form does not let it pass through creatures or solid objects.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 2 legendary actions and refreshes them at the start of its turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Treacherous Ice (1 action). Pick a point the dragon sees up to 120 ft. away. Ice coats the ground in a 20-ft. radius centered there. It is difficult terrain for creatures other than lunar dragons and lasts 10 minutes or until this option is used again.
sections.Lair: The dragon burrows a cave system inside a barren moon. Hidden chambers hold its hoard, often with spelljamming helms taken from trespassing ships. The caves may shelter springs, vents, wild plants, or life adapted to the moon.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects near the lair.
Black Frost. This frost coats the ground and kills ordinary plants within 3 miles of the lair.
Haunting Moan. The dragon chooses whether the moan grows louder or fainter as visitors approach. It is audible within 3 miles.
Moon Devils. Funnels of dust and frost intercept creatures within 1 mile of the lair. Each moon devil uses the Air Elemental stat block, acts independently, and deals cold damage in place of bludgeoning.
The moan and moon devils vanish when the dragon dies. The frost fades over 1d10 days and plants can recover.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 34, with the official Tail attack bonus correction. The lair and regional rules appear on pp. 33–34.

statBlock.name: Adult Solar Dragon
statBlock.description: A solar dragon patrols its hunting ground on glowing, cloudlike wings. It hunts kindori and scavvers and may approach a distant ship after mistaking it for prey.

sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach by flying does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Legendary Resistance (2/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.
Nebulous Thoughts. Magic that attempts to read the dragon’s mind or thoughts fails.
Siege Monster. Double damage against objects and structures.
Unusual Nature. The dragon needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Photonic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Center a 30-ft.-radius sphere on a point the dragon sees up to 180 ft. away. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 55 (10d10) radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions and refreshes them at the start of its turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Burst of Light (2 actions). The dragon emits magical light. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on the dragon makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is blinded through the end of its next turn.
sections.Lair: A solar dragon nests in the core of a star or within an immense hollow rock in its glare. An obsidian-shelled egg turns translucent just before it hatches.
sections.Regional effects:
Blinding Radiance. A creature inside the star or within 10 miles of it is blinded unless it wears eye protection such as Goggles of Night.
Stellar Incineration. A creature takes 132 (24d10) radiant damage when it enters the star or starts its turn inside it.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, pp. 51–52. The official errata renames Blinding Brilliance to Burst of Light. The adult retains the printed 20-ft. radius and DC 19.
